facts.text: Children, napkins on laps and elbows off the table. Pudding comes after the vegetables, and not one minute before.
facts.why: Mary Poppins doesn't say this. It is printed in quote marks. Her real lines include 'Practically perfect people never permit sentiment to muddle their thinking.'
facts.fix: Practically perfect people never permit sentiment to muddle their thinking.

fix_note.text: Practically perfect people never permit sentiment to muddle their thinking.

facts.text: Jane's spoonful, from Mary's medicine bottle.
facts.why: The transcript has the medicine poured with lime cordial, strawberry and rum punch as results, but nothing opened says whose dose is which, so Jane's lime cordial is unproven.
facts.fix: Mary's medicine bottle, poured for Jane and Michael.

vibe.verdict: A warm nursery tea with good food and wit, but dollar prices don't suit 1910 London.
missing: Feed the Birds and the tuppence (St Paul's)
Michael's tuppence and the bank run (Fidelity Fiduciary Bank)
Step in Time on the rooftops (Bert and the sweeps)
ideas: Swap 'St Paul's steps seeded crackers' for a tuppence bag of crumbs.
Swap 'Jolly Holiday raspberry granita' for a Jolly Holiday penguin tea set.
Change prices from dollars to shillings and pence.
Add a kite biscuit to replace 'Admiral Boom's ginger cannon fizz' note.
